items.summary: OpenFruit builds unmodified Xcode projects into signed iOS apps natively on Windows by tackling the complex toolchain requirements beyond basic Swift compilation. It resolves Xcode build settings by implementing a robust evaluation engine for layered .xcconfig files, conditional compilation flags, and inheritance rules. The system correctly selects XCFramework slices using available metadata and maps Apple's Mach-O macro plugins using an ARM64 CPU emulator. By handling resource compilers, old Swift language modes, and code signing natively on Windows without patching project files, OpenFruit enables real applications to build and run seamlessly.
items.bottom_line: Unmodified Xcode projects can now be fully compiled, signed, and built natively on Windows using custom emulators and build setting parsers.
